list_child.name: list_reports
list_child.desc: This tool returns the full list of incident reports currently held in the records system. It is the starting point for browsing the department's caseload.

get_child.name: get_report
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single incident report using its case number. It should be called once the specific report of interest has already been identified.

list_parent.name: list_complainants
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every complainant who has filed a report with the department. It is useful for cross-referencing individuals against their reported incidents.

get_parent.name: get_complainant
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single complainant's record by their unique identifier. It returns the contact and identifying details on file.

delete_child.name: purge_report
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes an incident report from the records system, and the deletion cannot be undone. It should only be used when a report is confirmed to be erroneous or duplicated.

set_enum.name: set_report_status
set_enum.desc: This tool updates the investigative status of an incident report, moving it between open, under investigation, closed, and unfounded. It should be used any time the case status changes.

set_bool.name: flag_suspect_identified
set_bool.desc: This tool records that a suspect has been identified in connection with an incident report. It should be used once investigators have a named or confirmed suspect.

set_ref.name: reassign_complainant
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns an incident report to a different complainant's record. It is used when a report was mistakenly logged under the wrong individual.

send.name: contact_complainant
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a complainant regarding the status of their report. It is the standard channel used to keep victims and witnesses informed.
